Send a POST request with JSON data using httpie
output:
http POST https://api.example.com/users name=Charlie email=charlie@example.com
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json

{
    "id": 3,
    "name": "Charlie",
    "email": "charlie@example.com"
}

Send a PUT request to update a resource with httpie
output:
http PUT https://api.example.com/users/1 name="Alice Smith" age:=30
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Alice Smith",
    "age": 30
}

instruction: Send a request with explicit Content-Type JSON using httpie
output:
http --json POST https://api.example.com/items name=Widget price:=9.99
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json

{
    "id": 42,
    "name": "Widget",
    "price": 9.99
}
